aiWorkflow: Resident sends a complaint, bill query, or visitor request.
AI classifies intent, extracts details, and checks society context.
Automation routes the task to the right role and suggests a response.
Realtime notifications update everyone until the task is resolved.

mobile.title: What the product delivers
list: Separate society branding, theme packs, and feature toggles.
Secure authentication with tenant-scoped access controls.
AI analytics, OCR extraction, translation, and automation workflows.
Android and iOS-ready architecture with realtime messaging.
